scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @hotai/db build && corepack pnpm --filter @hotai/ai build && corepack pnpm --filter @hotai/web build && corepack pnpm --filter @hotai/fetcher build
scripts.build:runtime: corepack pnpm --filter @hotai/db build && corepack pnpm --filter @hotai/ai build && corepack pnpm --filter @hotai/fetcher build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/db --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ai --noEmit && tsc -p apps/fetcher --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.smoke:dist: corepack pnpm run build:runtime && corepack pnpm --filter @hotai/fetcher smoke
